'''Tankers''' were vessels used to [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]]. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Nuna's Twins]]'' was a tanker.
